note: Coordinate→high-risk obligation mapping. The high-risk status of medical AI derives from Art.6(1)+Annex I (a safety component of an MDR medical device). A coordinate hit ≠ obligation violation — the mapping is a trigger clue; judge against the performance baseline and the clause original text. The clauses are bound to the 2026-09 status; EU guidance documents are still being published, so detailed obligations follow the latest official version.

high_risk_basis.reason: Medical AI is a safety component of an MDR (EU) 2017/745 medical device, automatically classified as high risk (not limited by Annex III)
high_risk_basis.timeline_note: The transparency clause has entered its 2026-08 effective period; the full obligation-application timeline follows the EU official phasing

forward.name: Factual Conflict (hallucination/misjudgment)
forward.requirement: reach the agreed accuracy level; inform deployers of system limitations
forward.action: label variant-interpretation output as 'high-risk for plausible hallucination'; disclose accuracy and known bias to the clinical side

forward.name: Self-Assessment Miscalibration (confident assertion)
forward.requirement: communicate uncertainty; humans can understand and challenge the output
forward.action: attach confidence intervals to reports; force review of high-confidence/low-evidence output

forward.name: Algorithmic Discrimination
forward.requirement: representative training data, bias detection; human oversight to identify discriminatory results
forward.action: embryo-selection models require sex/ethnicity performance disclosure; bias cross-check audits

forward.name: Inference Jump (chained hallucination)
forward.requirement: automatically log records to trace the output
forward.action: retain reasoning-chain logs to support retrospective review

forward.name: Credential Leakage
forward.action: credential management for the detection/medical-data pipeline

forward.name: System-Prompt Leakage
forward.requirement: the output must not disclose internal instructions

forward.name: Prompt Injection
forward.action: injection protection for free-text patient-input scenarios

forward.name: Autonomous Privilege Escalation
forward.action: least privilege for the agent tool chain; data-exfiltration gate

forward.name: Training/Retrieval Poisoning
forward.action: source audit of the variant database / knowledge base

forward.name: Unauthorized Task Assumption (excessive agency)
forward.requirement: humans are responsible for the authorization boundary
forward.action: AI must not give conclusions directly to patients; the genetic counselor makes the final decision

forward.name: Memory Decay (long-conversation amnesia)
forward.action: track and re-check patient history in long sessions

forward.name: Unverified Output
forward.requirement: output passes through a human gate
forward.action: institutionalize 'all AI output is a pending-verification clue'

general_obligations.requirement: high-risk systems automatically log records (retain 6 months)
general_obligations.tact_link: the gate-passing event ledger directly provides the data basis for this obligation

general_obligations.requirement: incidents causing injury/death/serious health damage must be reported to the authorities
general_obligations.tact_link: after an injury event is coordinate-coded, the report material can directly cite coordinate + criterion + verification path

reverse_obligation_monitoring.monitor_coordinates: rolling gate ledger: a new error coordinate appearing triggers a risk-register update
passing the M2-5/P7-1 gate: per-group performance sampling

reverse_obligation_monitoring.requirement: inform users of AI interaction and limitations
reverse_obligation_monitoring.monitor_coordinates: M2-3/M2-2 hit rate as 'limitation disclosure' data

reverse_obligation_monitoring.requirement: performance meets standard, adversarial resistance, leak prevention
reverse_obligation_monitoring.monitor_coordinates: M2-2/M6-3/M4-2 hit rate as acceptance metric
injury-type events (e.g., P8-5) automatically enter the reporting flow

compliance_checklist.action: variant-interpretation output attaches confidence + limitation statement
